tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything; light white, dark near-black.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures on background, card and popover (19:1 light, 17:1 dark).

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and sections; a 1 px ring (foreground at 10%) separates them from the page.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one committing button (Approve, Send) and the human's avatar: near-black in light, near-white in dark. Monochrome — no brand hue.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: agent avatars, skeletons, hover rows, empty-state media.

tokens.name: muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, metadata, timestamps, idle icons. 4.7:1 on background light (4.3:1 on muted, as shadcn ships it); 6.9:1+ dark.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Hover and highlighted items in menus and lists (gray, not a hue).

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Down / loss / sell, Halt, Reject, breached limits, errors. Always with a − sign, arrow or icon + word.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Up / gain / buy, Filled, agent working. Always with a + sign, arrow or icon + word. 5.2:1 on background light, 9:1 dark.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Attention, not error: stale data, pending approval, near a limit, agent waiting. 4.9:1 on background light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: ring
tokens.usage: Focus ring (used at 50%, beside a border change). Gray, as shadcn ships it.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Chart series 1 (lightest). Charts are grayscale; series differ by lightness. Never applied to the TradingView chart.

tokens.name: sidebar-primary
tokens.usage: Sidebar active/brand mark (monochrome in both themes).

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: balance
styles.usage: The hero figure of a page (total equity on Overview, a position's value). One per page, tabular. Revolut-style balance.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: Page heading, top-left under the breadcrumb.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: CardTitle and section headings inside a page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The Portfolio Manager approved the NVDA proposal.
styles.usage: Default UI text: table cells, descriptions, messages.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, buttons, menu items, column headers (muted-foreground for headers).

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, badges, helper text; muted-foreground.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Tool names and JSON payloads in agent tool logs.

tokens.name: spacing
tokens.usage: Tailwind's base step: every p-*, m-*, gap-* is a multiple (gap-2 = 8px, p-4 = 16px, p-6 = 24px).

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and sections on a page (gap-6).

tokens.name: space-page
tokens.usage: Page padding inside the sidebar inset (p-6; p-4 on phones).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: The one radius knob, 14px (softer, banking-app cards). Derived: sm 8.4, md 11.2 (buttons, inputs), lg 14, xl 19.6 (cards), 2xl 25.2, 3xl 30.8, 4xl 36.4 (badges, pills).

meta.note: v3: radius 14px, motion everywhere, all shadcn Base UI components + AI Fund blocks.

easing.note: Motion curves; durations live with each motion utility.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Things arriving: cards rising in (.ds-reveal 420 ms, 60 ms stagger), bars growing (.ds-grow-x 620 ms).

tokens.name: ease-out-quint
tokens.usage: Feedback: hover lift (.ds-lift 200 ms), price flash (900 ms), count-up (600 ms).
